project_type: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + Neon Postgres backend, React 19 + Vite + TypeScript frontend, Python migration/analysis packages
build_system: pip/pyproject.toml for Python, npm/vite for frontend. No monorepo tools detected beyond directory separation.
test_framework: pytest for Python backend (88 passing tests), vitest for TypeScript (demo repo tests)
build_command: npm run build (frontend in apps/web/), no explicit backend build step beyond pip install
test_command: pytest tests/ -v (backend), npm run test (if added to web)
verification_instructions: 1. Start backend: uvicorn apps.api.app.main:app --reload --port 8000. 2. Verify /health returns 200. 3. Start frontend: cd apps/web && npm run dev. 4. Verify http://localhost:5173 loads. 5. Run pytest tests/ to confirm no regressions.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that are checked in. Database migrations use SQLAlchemy models directly via apps/api/app/db/init_db.py. Frontend builds to apps/web/dist/ but is not committed.
environment_constraints: Requires DATABASE_URL (Neon pooled) and DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED (direct) for Postgres. GEMINI_API_KEY for LLM fallback. GITHUB_DEMO_REPO_PATH optional for demo repo override. Never commit .env. Backend runs on :8000, frontend on :5173. Use cloudflared for public tunnel (brew install cloudflared).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Inferred: Follow existing test coverage patterns (pytest for backend, vitest stub for frontend). Use existing style: black-style spacing in Python, lucide-react icons in frontend, vanilla CSS with CSS custom properties. All API routes under /api/ prefix. Database session via get_db() dependency. Frontend API client in apps/web/src/api/client.ts uses fetch with API_BASE from env.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI routers in apps/api/app/api/routes/, SQLAlchemy models in apps/api/app/models/db_models.py with Base from session.py, Pydantic request models inline in route files. Frontend: Page components in apps/web/src/pages/, reusable components in apps/web/src/components/, API calls centralized in client.ts. Packages: change_engine (diff.py, classifier.py), repository_analyzer (scanner.py, typescript/parser.py), impact_engine (analyzer.py), migration_engine (planner.py, recipes/, llm/), validation (sandbox.py, runner.py), github (client.py, pr_template.py). All packages have models.py for domain types.
directory_structure: Root: apps/ (api/, web/), packages/ (change_engine/, repository_analyzer/, impact_engine/, migration_engine/, validation/, github/), tests/ (fixtures/api-v1/, fixtures/api-v2/, fixtures/demo-repository/, test_*.py), scripts/ (run_demo.py, seed_demo.py), demo-repo/ (Next.js demo target with src/, tests/), .kiro/ (specs/), .env (gitignored)
